Overlaps with sections 2 and 3 above: **2.2** (`ModelSwitcher.tsx` regrouping a static constant every render) and **3.1** (`runtime.server.ts` re-deriving the same `userId→accountId→plan_tier` chain 3-6x per call) are both, at root, the same computation running more than once for unchanged input. No further redundant-computation findings cleared the bar — `capabilities.functions.ts`'s `computeAllAgentTrust` was checked and confirmed genuinely single-pass, not per-agent, as its own comment claims.

---

**Not re-flagged** (confirmed already fixed in earlier sessions today): `orchestrator.functions.ts` batch insert, `capabilities.functions.ts` invariant hoist + `pLimit(8)`, `AutoClustered.tsx`/`SignalFeed.tsx` memo (were false positives), `OpportunityQueue.tsx` `BoundOpportunityRow`, `GraphUniverseCanvas.tsx` RAF visibility guard, `AskPanel.tsx` SSE unmount cleanup, `MissionOrchestratorDetail.tsx` `useMemo`.

All findings are independently fixable with no schema changes. I've saved this audit to memory (superseding the 07-19 morning check) so the next session can pick up directly from `resume-runs.ts` rather than re-discovering it. Want me to implement the fixes, starting with the high-severity `resume-runs.ts` one?

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
This audit builds on three prior sweeps done earlier this session (2026-07-09, 07-12, 07-18/19) — rather than re-scanning blind, I fed the performance-optimizer agent the known-open findings with exact file:line citations and asked it to verify + extend. Two patterns recur across the whole codebase: (1) a proven batch-write fix in `linear.functions.ts` and `orchestrator.functions.ts` that hasn't been ported to two sibling files with the identical N+1 shape, and (2) a proven 5-minute TTL cache in `runtime.server.ts`'s `creditsEnabled()` that hasn't been reused for other rarely-changing lookups (plan tier, BYOK eligibility). Once you have one correct pattern in a codebase, the fastest audit technique is often "grep for its unfixed siblings," not full pattern-matching from scratch.
